_comment: V1 cab-high bed shell. All lengths in metres. Values marked UNVERIFIED in docs/compatibility.md must be replaced with measurements from the Road Trip F-150 (gaming PC) before production fit.
name: f150_bed_shell_v1

axes._comment: Blender scene axes as authored. SCS Blender Tools handles the Blender->game axis conversion on export; verify facing in the first export test.

origin._comment: Object origin = top of bed rails, centred left/right, at the bed's front wall. Must match the accessory locator found in the vehicle defs (UNVERIFIED).

bed._comment: UNVERIFIED placeholders for a 2023 F-150 5.5 ft bed; replace from the measured in-game model. length_at_rails = published 67.1 in box length. width_at_rails is the OUTER rail-to-rail width the shell base sits on: published inside width is ~65.2 in (1.65 m); outer adds the rail caps (estimate ~0.15 m per side, so ~1.95 m against a 2.03 m body). Set it to 1.65 to fit the shell inside the rails instead.

shell._comment: Factory-style cab-high cap. Rakes/tumblehome are top-edge offsets in metres. roof_crown is extra height at the centreline. edge_bevel rounds every outer edge (bevel_segments segments).

windows._comment: Openings are cut through the wall (exact boolean); glass panes sit glass_inset behind the outer skin. Side margins are measured on the flat side panel from the front/rear/bottom/top of the shell.

shell_paint._comment: THE shared render body paint: 'Iconic Silver'-like mid-light metallic silver (approximation, not a factory colour code). Used by render_preview and, via "paint": "config/v1.json#materials.shell_paint", by every variant's truck + colour-matched camper. Render-only keys (flake, dirt) are ignored by build_scene; the exported SCS material takes its colour from the game's truck paint (eut2.truckpaint), not from base_color.

scs._comment: UNVERIFIED placeholders. model_path is relative to the SCS project base (the --output dir); real game def path/accessory name must come from the vehicle defs on the gaming PC.

preview._comment: Render-only stand-in truck (original low-poly geometry, generic and debadged, never exported). Approximate published 2023 F-150 SuperCrew 5.5 ft dims; paint comes from materials.shell_paint.
